summary.intent: Fix CI release gate logic to correctly distinguish between failed and skipped E2E jobs, then align the desktop E2E skipped-job handling to match the web E2E pattern.
summary.outcome: Both web and desktop E2E checks now use consistent three-state logic (failed/skipped/passed). Two PR review threads were resolved and the structural alignment was committed and pushed.

repo: release-gate.yml contains separate check steps for web E2E and desktop E2E with matrix jobs
Desktop E2E uses a matrix across platforms; all platform jobs must pass (success == total), not just some
Web E2E originally used if/else structure; desktop originally used if+exit 0 then separate fallback — now aligned

code.finding: Three-state logic pattern: fail fast if job result == 'failure', skip/pass if result == 'skipped', otherwise verify success count matches total for matrix jobs

workflow: PR review threads should be replied to and resolved after pushing fixes
Structural inconsistency between two parallel checks (web vs desktop) is worth aligning even if both are functionally correct

friction: Anthropic API quota was hit mid-session, interrupting work between the edit and the commit/push steps
